page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre-left with page number at top right. Main text in one full-width column, with arithmetic display (division worked out in lines) in the upper middle, followed by text below it. No marginal notes. Catchword and signature: none visible.
page.notes: The arithmetic display is a worked long-division layout with fractions (7/12, 1/2, 1/3) and partial products; I have copied its lines in order as they stand, with the column arrangement flattened to pipes. Some superscript or small digits in the display (such as the "2" beside 293 and the "3" in 595) may be misplaced in this rendering. The fractions are typeset as stacked numerators and denominators. The text "Gemmę Frisii" is printed with a ligature-like character which I read as æ/ę, copied as Gemmæ. No printed notes, no headings, no catchword. The line "Lecturi" is set as a running paragraph.
